scope: Fresh Ubuntu 24.04 focused project compilation and exact ordered audit of 863 named declarations at the recorded commit. Excludes the six standalone audits, separately published 46 encoded-program and 193 physical-bridge audits, the full original three-export audit, and strict Comparator replay.

environment.dependency_cache: Official upstream Mathlib cache trusted; no cross-job project proof artifacts restored.
environment.independent_rebuild_boundary: Fresh project closure on Linux; trusted Mathlib cache and Lean bootstrap binaries were reused.

verification_method.exact_commit_source_checks: All environment-recorded formal Lean/config source paths and SHA256 values matched git show at the recorded full commit; no current-working-tree inference.
verification_method.ordered_named_audit_checks: Exact committed driver name order/count, standard three-axiom allowlist, no extra report-block output; independently checked returned reports and checker policy.

input_artifact_provenance.retrieval: Authenticated GitHub connector; original downloaded archive and metadata retained as private evidence.

log_processing.axiom_audit_log: Exact report-block extraction from the complete verification log; standard checker summary and surrounding build output are retained in verification.log.

bootstrap-lean.log.bootstrap_cr_transform: CRLF -> LF; each remaining CR -> LF; no terminal-overwrite or segment discard

historical_boundary: Earlier checkpoint receipts, Python 237 test record and failed v2 intake remain unchanged; this run does not add sampler/runtime or counting claims.
